details: Analysis of this package version surfaced no a static rule matches and no traced code behaviors indicating supply-chain attack patterns. No lifecycle scripts performing remote fetch-and-execute, no credential or environment variable harvesting, no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations, no silent-relay shape, and no namespace-abuse / dropper signals were observed across the scanned files. The package name pattern (combining well-known tooling tokens) could be a confusion-style name relative to mainstream ESLint plugins, but name similarity alone without a payload is not sufficient to classify as a typosquat attack.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
